title: Reproducible research experiment report
description: Every experiment produces a consistently structured report whose records are backed by evidence collected outside the process that ran the experiment.

applicability.description: Single-process, CPU-only experiments whose outputs are files in one directory.

requirements.title: Artifact conforms to the IR schema
Every listed output exists and matches its recorded size and SHA-256
Every reported metric equals the value at its pointer in a hashed output
requirements.rationale: A metric in the report must be traceable to a file whose integrity R-002 covers.

requirements.title: Source, environment, dataset, config, execution and output digests were recorded by the collector
requirements.rationale: Producer-asserted metadata is a claim, not evidence.

requirements.title: Source is pinned to a clean revision or a hashed snapshot
Every finding references metrics, figures or outputs that exist in the artifact
requirements.rationale: Checks that support is cited, not that the citation justifies the statement (see R-009).

requirements.title: Findings and limitations are justified by the evidence
